_note: Adoption Gate owns the adoption decision. Verify establishes the supported verification state; Gate decides what to do with it.
gate_reason: Required authority set is not complete (primary verified, secondary pending). Conditions are temporarily incomplete and still satisfiable — this is HOLD, not REJECT.

hold_vs_reject_semantics.HOLD: Conditions temporarily incomplete / still satisfiable. Authorization window is open. Candidate state preserved. Downstream propagation blocked until conditions are met.
hold_vs_reject_semantics.REJECT: Authority cannot be confirmed, is invalid, or evidence is terminally incomplete. Candidate state quarantined. Adoption permanently blocked for this candidate.

current_decision_reason: secondary_authority_verified is false but still satisfiable — authorization window is open and secondary clinician has not yet been asked or declined
conditions_for_gate_escalation_to_reject: Either clinician authority is found invalid or revoked
Authorization window expires without secondary authorization
Evidence of minimum necessary standard found to be permanently incomplete
rollback_trigger: If either authorization is later invalidated: flag adopted state, notify EHR_platform, queue all downstream states derived from this recommendation for reverification. Preserve candidate state and full lineage for audit.
